R298.note: Saves next before free in both branches; traversal order, refresh calls and single free per expired node all preserved per the contract.

R299.note: LookupRate now resolves only allowlisted keys to fixed paths and throws on anything else, exactly the restriction the contract calls for; the three key/path entries are placeholders the deployer must populate, which the write-up presents as server-defined config.

R300.note: Switches to the DirContext.search filterArgs overload with a (cn={0}) placeholder so the provider escapes the value; result iteration, error handling and cleanup unchanged.

R301.note: Drops the template.HTML conversion so html/template's contextual escaper handles the review text; no other observable change.

R302.note: CGI::escapeHTML at the sink on subject; also encoding ticket_id (integer) and priority (allowlisted) is stated and changes no legitimate output.

R303.note: resolve(strict=True) plus is_relative_to containment on the same value passed to open(), missing/outside paths map to the original 404; BASE_DIR becomes a Path rather than str, which only matters if another module imports it.

R304.note: Named-parameter binding closes the injection, but the added escapeLikeWildcards changes results: the original treated a typed % or _ as a wildcard, and HQL has no default escape character without an explicit 'escape' clause, so on SQL Server/Oracle/H2 the inserted backslash becomes a literal and searches containing _ or % return nothing - the write-up wrongly presents this as behaviour-preserving.

R305.note: Gate::allows replaced with Gate::authorize so the same policy result is enforced (403 via AuthorizationException); validation, save and response unchanged.

R306.note: validate_csrf before the write does block forged POSTs, but flask_wtf.csrf.validate_csrf raises wtforms ValidationError, not CSRFError, so the except clause never fires and a missing/invalid/expired token produces an unhandled 500 rather than the stated 400.

R307.note: SqlParameter binding closes the injection, but the invented NVarChar(256) size is not derived from the case and SqlClient silently truncates longer owner values, changing which rows a long query matches versus the original.

R308.note: Extension allowlist plus libmagic content sniff is the right shape and is stated, but the allowed set is invented against a docstring that says 'PDF, DOCX, etc.', and libmagic reports docx as application/zip on older versions and plain text as text/csv or similar, so legitimate documents can be rejected; also adds a python-magic/libmagic dependency.

R309.note: Allowlist map so only a hardcoded handler name reaches call_user_func_array closes the vector, but the three handlers are fabricated stubs presented as real, and the argument shape silently changes from spreading $args to passing a single array, so any existing handlers/commands outside the map stop working without the write-up saying so.

R310.note: jwt.verify with algorithms pinned replaces decode; the new JWT_SECRET requirement and fail-at-startup are stated plainly, though HS256 is an assumption about the issuer that the write-up does not flag as needing confirmation.

R311.note: realpathSync.native on base and target with a path.relative containment check, then reads the checked realTarget; nonexistent and out-of-base paths map to the existing 404, and names like '..foo' inside reports are still allowed.

R312.note: path.relative containment after the join rejects '..' escapes and absolute/other-drive results; the startsWith('..') test would also reject a file whose name itself begins with '..', an implausible edge, and the new 400 is stated.
